home.subtitle: Noctua is a Barcelona nightlife discovery app. Find and explore the best clubs, bars, live events, festivals and late-night essentials. Create a free account to save your favourite venues and plan your night with AI.
home.about_text: Noctua is a Barcelona nightlife discovery platform. We help users find and explore the best clubs, bars, live events, festivals and late-night essentials. Users can create a free account to save favourite venues and plan their night with AI. Noctua uses Google Sign-In to allow users to log in quickly and securely. We only access your name and email address to create and manage your Noctua account.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Noctua collects, uses and protects your information.
privacy.s1_body: Noctua ("we", "our") is a nightlife discovery platform focused on Barcelona. We operate the website and app available at noctuaapp.com. For any privacy-related question, contact us at {email}.
privacy.s2_intro: We collect the following categories of data:
privacy.s2_items:
Account data::Email address, encrypted password, username and, if provided, gender, when you sign up.
Profile photo::The image you voluntarily upload as your account avatar.
Usage data::Pages visited, clubs and events viewed, and searches performed.
Favorites::Clubs, events and club nights you choose to save, along with the lists and personal notes you create to organize them.
Activity and points (XP)::If you mark that you'll attend an event, check in at a club, or earn experience points, we store that activity to show your progress and level within the app.
Precise location (check-in only)::When you choose to check in on a club's page, we access your GPS location once to confirm you're near the venue. We don't store your coordinates — only which club and on which day you checked in.
Contact messages::Any message you send us through the Contact page, including requests to manage your club's or festival's listing.
Verified venue and festival accounts::If you're responsible for a club or festival and we grant you access to edit its listing, we link your account to that venue or event. Only you and the Noctua team can manage that listing from there.
In-app notifications::The notices we send you within Noctua (for example, confirmations or messages from the team) and whether you've read them.
Device data and analytics::Browser type, device type and approximate location (at country/city level) for usage analysis, via Vercel Analytics.
privacy.s3_intro: We use the data we collect to:
privacy.s3_items:
Provide and operate the Noctua platform.
Save and display your favorite clubs, events and club nights.
Calculate your progress and level within Noctua's points (XP) system.
Verify your location at the moment of check-in at a club (we never store it, only the result).
Respond to messages and support requests, including messages the Noctua team sends you directly.
Grant management access to verified venue or festival managers over their own listing, while Noctua's team always retains the ability to review, correct or revoke that access.
Improve the platform based on usage patterns.
Send important service communications (no marketing without your consent).
privacy.s4_body: We process your data under the following legal bases defined by the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR): contract performance (to provide the service you signed up for), legitimate interest (to improve and protect the platform), and consent (for optional communications). You can withdraw your consent at any time.
privacy.s5_body: Your data is stored securely using Supabase, which offers professional-grade encryption both at rest and in transit. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel only.
privacy.s6_body: We retain your account data for as long as your account remains active. If you delete your account, all associated personal data will be permanently deleted within 30 days. Contact messages are retained for up to 12 months for support purposes.
privacy.s7_intro: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
privacy.s7_items:
Access the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate data.
Request deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten').
Object to or restrict the processing of your data.
Receive a copy of your data in a portable format.
File a complaint with your local data protection authority.
privacy.s7_closing: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}.
privacy.s8_body: We use essential cookies necessary for authentication and session management, plus local browser storage (localStorage) to remember preferences such as which notices you've already read. We also use Vercel Analytics, an analytics tool that doesn't use tracking cookies or individually identify users, to understand in aggregate how the Platform is used. We don't use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. No third-party ad network has access to your data.
privacy.s9_intro: We work with the following providers to operate the Platform, each processing data only to the extent necessary to provide their service:
privacy.s9_items:
Supabase::Authentication, database and image storage. Processes data in accordance with the GDPR.
Vercel::Application hosting and aggregated, anonymous usage analytics.
Mapbox::Renders the maps within the app. When a map loads, Mapbox may receive your IP address and the technical information needed to display it.
Google Places::Source of public data (name, rating, reviews and photos) for clubs, festivals and essential services shown on their listings. We do not send your personal data to Google through this integration.
privacy.s9_closing: We do not share your personal data with any other third party unless required by law.
privacy.s10_intro: Noctua allows users to sign in with their Google account via Google OAuth 2.0. When you choose to sign in with Google, we receive the following information from Google:
privacy.s10_items:
Name::Your profile name registered with Google.
Email::Used to create and identify your Noctua account.
Profile photo::Optionally displayed on your Noctua profile.
privacy.s10_closing: We do not access your Google contacts, Google Drive, Gmail or any other Google service. Data received from Google is used solely to create and manage your Noctua account. You can revoke Noctua's access to your Google account at any time from your {googleSettings}.
privacy.s11_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we'll update the date at the top of this page. Continued use of Noctua after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s12_body: For any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at {email}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1_body: By accessing or using Noctua ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you don't agree to these terms, please don't use the Platform. We reserve the right to update these terms at any time; continued use constitutes acceptance of any changes.
terms.s2_body: Noctua is a nightlife discovery platform offering information about clubs, events and nightlife, currently focused on Barcelona and progressively expanding to other areas of the Catalan coast. We are an informational platform — we do not operate venues, organize events or sell tickets directly. We may introduce additional features in the future, including paid features aimed at venues and organizers (for example, featured placement or listing statistics); if that happens, their specific terms will be communicated and accepted separately.
terms.s3_intro: By creating an account, you agree to:
terms.s3_items:
Provide accurate and complete information.
Keep your password secure and confidential.
Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
Be responsible for all activity that occurs under your account.
terms.s3_closing: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account on Noctua, given the nature of the nightlife content.
terms.s4_items:
Use the Platform for unlawful purposes.
Extract, copy or reproduce content without permission.
Attempt unauthorized access to any part of the Platform.
Submit false, misleading or defamatory information.
Interfere with or disrupt the operation of the Platform.
Use the Platform to send unsolicited commercial communications.
terms.s5_intro: If you're responsible for a club or festival, after contacting us and verifying your identity we may link your account to the corresponding listing, giving you access to edit it directly. By using this access, you agree that:
terms.s5_items:
The information you publish (hours, prices, photos, nights or sessions) is accurate and up to date.
You only publish content you hold the necessary rights to.
Noctua may review, correct or remove content that breaches these Terms at any time.
Noctua reserves the right to revoke your management access to a listing at any time, for example if your relationship with the venue can no longer be verified.
terms.s6_body: We strive to keep all venue and event information accurate and up to date. However, we cannot guarantee the accuracy, completeness or currency of information on the Platform — including content published directly by verified venue or festival managers. Always verify details directly with the venue before attending. Each venue's entry policies (dress code, capacity, minimum age or other entry conditions) are the venue's sole responsibility; Noctua does not guarantee entry to any club, event or festival.
terms.s7_body: All content on the Platform, including text, graphics, logos and design, is owned by Noctua or its content providers and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. You may not reproduce, distribute or create derivative works without our express written permission.
terms.s8_body: The Platform may contain links to third-party websites, including venue websites and ticket-selling platforms. These links are provided for convenience only. We have no control over, and assume no responsibility for, the content or practices of such sites.
terms.s9_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Noctua will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages arising from use of the Platform. Our total liability for any claim will not exceed the amount you paid for use of the Platform in the 12 months prior to the claim.
terms.s10_body: The Platform is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the Platform will be free of interruptions or errors.
terms.s11_body: Noctua offers an optional experience points (XP) and levels system that rewards certain in-app actions (marking attendance, checking in at a venue, usage streaks, etc.). XP points have no monetary value, are not transferable or redeemable for cash, and do not constitute a currency or financial product. We reserve the right to modify, reset or discontinue the points program, as well as adjust how points are awarded, at any time.
terms.s12_body: We reserve the right to suspend or cancel your account at our discretion if you breach these Terms of Service. You can delete your account at any time from your Profile page.
terms.s13_body: These Terms of Service are governed by the laws of Spain. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Barcelona, Spain.
terms.s14_body: For any questions about these Terms of Service, contact us at {email}.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Noctua.
faq.teamHelp: Our team will be happy to help.
faq.cat1_items:
What is Noctua?||Noctua is a nightlife discovery platform. It helps you find the best clubs, festivals and club nights, with verified information all in one place.
Is Noctua free to use?||Yes, Noctua is completely free for users. You can explore clubs, discover events and save your favorites at no cost.
Which cities does Noctua cover?||Right now we focus on Barcelona. We plan to progressively expand to other areas of the Catalan coast, starting with Sitges.
What languages is Noctua available in?||You can use the app in several languages from the language selector. Some dynamic content, such as Google reviews, is shown in Spanish.
faq.cat2_items:
Do I need an account to use Noctua?||You can explore clubs and events without creating an account. However, creating a free account lets you save favorites, earn experience points (XP), and access personalized features.
How do I create an account?||Tap the profile icon or go to /signup. You just need an email and password, or you can sign up with your Google account.
How do I change my password?||Go to your Profile and tap Change password. You'll receive a link by email to reset it securely.
How do I delete my account?||You can request account deletion from your Profile page. All your data, including saved favorites, will be permanently deleted.
Do I need to be 18 to use Noctua?||Yes. Given the nature of the nightlife content, you must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use the app.
faq.cat3_items:
How do I save a club or event?||Tap the heart icon on any club, night or festival listing. You'll find everything saved under Favorites, in the bottom navigation bar.
What does "Trending" mean?||Trending clubs are the ones generating the most interest in Barcelona's nightlife right now.
What does "Sold Out" mean?||It means tickets or capacity for that event or club night are no longer available.
Can I buy tickets through Noctua?||Noctua doesn't sell tickets directly. When a club or festival has tickets available, we link you to their official website or ticketing platform.
What is check-in and experience points (XP)?||You can check in when you're at a club to earn experience points and level up within the app. It's an optional system with no monetary value.
faq.cat4_items:
How do I get my club, bar or festival featured on Noctua?||Use our Contact page and choose "Suggest a venue" (for clubs and bars) or the corresponding partnership category for festivals. We review all submissions and will get back to you.
I'm responsible for a club or festival — can I manage my own listing?||Yes. Message us from Contact choosing "Manage my club or event". Once we verify you're responsible for it, we'll link your account and you'll be able to edit your listing, photos, prices and nights or sessions directly.
I've found incorrect information about a venue. How do I report it?||Use the Contact page and choose "Report incorrect information". Tell us the venue's name and what's wrong — we'll update it as soon as possible.
faq.cat5_items:
How does Noctua protect my data?||Your data is stored securely and never sold to third parties. You can find all the details in our Privacy Policy.
Who can I talk to if I have a problem?||Message us from the Contact page choosing "User support" and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
